title: Telly Swing
tagline: Swing, plug in and power your way home!
description: Telly is a little cartoon TV with a power cord. Roll and jump through eight hand-built rooms, swing from hooks, push crates onto plates and plug into sockets that power doors, lifts, fans and bridges, then plug in at the gold outlet. Three stars a room.
how_to: ◀ ▶ roll Telly along and ⤒ jumps (on a keyboard: the arrows and Space).
🔌 near a glowing hook throws the cord: hold to swing, let go to fly. Swing right round to wrap it for speed.
🔌 beside a socket plugs in and powers a door, lift, fan or bridge, often only for a while, so hurry. Crates on plates work too.
Grab ⚡ and the three 🔋 in each room, then plug into the gold outlet. Mind water and sparks!
